# CANDIDATE: VWAP_EXTREME_MEAN_REVERT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY extends far above VWAP with overbought RSI(14) > 70 and a flat EMA ribbon (EMA8≈EMA21≈EMA55 within 0.1×ATR), the session is overextended in a chop/low-vol regime. Intraday mean reversion to VWAP offers an edge because: (1) the ribbon flatness signals no trend fuel, (2) RSI extreme signals exhaustion, (3) VWAP acts as the institutional anchor. Best in VIX < 15, after 10:00 ET to avoid gap noise.

## Mechanism

**Entry (all must be true on a closed 5-min bar):**
- Price > VWAP + 1.5 × ATR(14)
- RSI(14) > 70
- |EMA8 - EMA21| < 0.1 × ATR(14) AND |EMA21 - EMA55| < 0.1 × ATR(14) (ribbon flat)
- Time ≥ 10:00 ET
- VIX (spot or 5-min proxy) < 15
- No strong trend: NOT (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 by > 0.2 × ATR)

**Entry action:** Enter SHORT at the close of the triggering bar (market order on next bar open).

**Exit:**
- Stop: Highest high of last 3 bars (chart stop)
- Target 1 (≈1R): VWAP — sell 2/3 at VWAP touch
- Runner (1/3): Chandelier trail at 0.5×ATR from high-water mark after 50% of target reached
- Time stop: 15:50 ET flat all

**Regime filter:** Only active when VIX < 15 (low vol/chop). Disable when VIX ≥ 15 or ribbon sharply aligned (trending).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Stage-1 used BS-synthetic pricing with 3-contract minimum (≈$300–$500 deployed per trade at $1.00–$1.67 premium). $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline; $25K+ needed for full 3-contract deployment at 50% risk cap.

2. **Sample bias:** Single 16-month SPY 5-min window (2025-01 to 2026-06), 225 trades generated. Selection method: free-agent ideation thesis, no prior optimization on this data. High overfit risk — the VWAP+ATR+RSI+ribbon-flat combo has 4+ degrees of freedom. J's 7 anchor days are a tiny subset (n=7) — any anchor-day claim is extremely noisy.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS — Stage-1 is full-window IS only. No walk-forward or held-out window tested yet.

4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS — Stage-1 used Black-Scholes synthetic pricing (IV=VIX/100). Real OPRA bid/ask spreads, skew, and fill slippage not modeled. Per L12/L23, BS sim systematically overestimates entry premium for ITM 0DTE by 10-25%.

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 2025-Q3 −$1,134 (low-vol chop regime where mean reversion fails)
   - Max drawdown: $4,701 (IS)
   - Blow-up scenario: Strong trending day (ribbon not flat) where VWAP deviation extends → repeated stop-outs at 3-bar highs. Strategy fires false shorts in trends.
   - Concentration: top5_pct = 999% (wide_pnl negative, top 5 days positive) — edge entirely concentrated in 5/04 (+$804) and a few other days.

6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 999% of wide_pnl (wide_pnl = −$1,464, top 5 days net positive). 5/04 alone contributes +$804 (55% of gross winners). Only 2/6 quarters positive (2025-Q2, 2026-Q1). Regime-dependent: works in chop, bleeds in trend.
